verses.text: Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of gods. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the Lord of lords. His faithful love lasts forever.
He alone does great wonders. His faithful love lasts forever.
With his understanding he made the skies. His faithful love lasts forever.
He spread out the earth on the waters. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the great lights. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the sun to rule the day. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt. His faithful love lasts forever.
He brought Israel out from among them. His faithful love lasts forever.
He did it with a strong hand and a powerful arm. His faithful love lasts forever.
He split the Red Sea in two. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led Israel through the middle of it. His faithful love lasts forever.
But he swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led his people through the wilderness. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down great kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed mighty kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed Sihon king of the Amorites. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed Og king of Bashan. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gave their land as an inheritance. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gave it to his servant Israel. His faithful love lasts forever.
He remembered us when we were brought low. His faithful love lasts forever.
He rescued us from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gives food to every living creature. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of heaven. His faithful love lasts forever.
